arxiv-2211-00493.title: A fast, accurate, and easy to implement Kapur-Rokhlin quadrature scheme for singular integrals in axisymmetric geometries
arxiv-2211-00493.creator: Evan Toler \aff 1 \corresp, A. J. Cerfon \aff 1, D. Malhotra \aff 2
arxiv-2211-00493.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Evan Toler \aff 1 \corresp, A. J. Cerfon \aff 1, D. Malhotra \aff 2. Many applications in magnetic confinement fusion require the efficient calculation of surface integrals with singular integrands. The singularity subtraction approaches typically used to handle such singularities are complicated to implement and low order accurate. In contrast, we demonstrate that the Kapur-Rokhlin quadrature scheme is well-suited for the logarithmically singular integrals encountered for a toroidally axisymmetric confinement system, is easy to implement, and is high order accurate.
